text:
Asha V.: Heads-up — Solstice Retail renewal in ~5 weeks. We just flagged a ~60% drop in API usage after their ML lead left. Procurement mentioned they're running a ClearModel side-by-side. Need fast triage. :triage: 
Marco J.: Oof. Which endpoints and is it an auth/key rotation? Any error spikes?
Asha V.: Quick console clip:
```
30d active keys: 860 -> 340 (-60%)
Top routes: /chat (-62%), /embeds-bulk (-47%)
Error rate: 0.5% (stable)
p95 latency: 300ms
```
Asha V.: Champion (Head of Product Analytics) supportive but paused while new PM ramps. Procurement asked for a short reliability & cost comparison and a migration note.
Priya Nair: Triage plan proposal:
• Health call with champion + new PM (owner: Asha) — confirm procurement timeline
• Competitor snapshot vs ClearModel (owner: Marco) — 1 page, include cost, latency, embeddings parity
• Quick cost/perf bake-off on their top prompts (owner: Devon) — run quantized + batched test
• Enablement: 45m workshop for new PM + engs (owner: Priya)
Devon K.: I'll run the perf job once they share top prompts and a small eval rubric. ETA initial artifacts: 72h. Need sample prompts + golden responses.
eng-bot: Ticket CS-9055 created: "Solstice Retail - quant & perf bakeoff" assigned to Devon K., due in 3 business days.
Lila - CS Lead: Also propose a short exec nudge to their VP of Data ~2w before renewal. I'll coordinate with Sales if we recommend a short concession.
Jordan (RevOps): If a concession is proposed, include ARR impact and approvers. I'll standby for numbers.
Marco J.: I'll draft the ClearModel snapshot: unit cost, latency p50/p95, embeddings/semantic parity notes, SDK/infra migration friction. ETA 48h.
Priya Nair: Enablement checklist: integration walkthrough, cost levers (batching/caching/quant), rollback plan, and 3 quick wins. Keep it hands-on.
Asha V.: Action items (owners & due dates):
- Request sample prompts + confirm champion/new PM time (Asha) — due today EOD
- Competitor one-pager vs ClearModel (Marco) — due in 48h
- Quant + batching perf run & artifacts (Devon via CS-9055) — due in 3 business days
- Enablement workshop scheduling + materials (Priya) — schedule by EOD tomorrow
- Draft short renewal playbook + concession options (Asha + Lila + Jordan) — draft in 72h
Lila - CS Lead: Please CC me on the health call invite. Keep the health call <=30m and focused: procurement timeline, who owns the bench test, and whether ClearModel is full migration or parallel eval.
Devon K.: If quant+batch shows ~30% cost improvement with <5% quality delta on their rubric, that will be our strongest retention lever. Will include diff examples.
Marco J.: I'll include a short migration checklist (embeddings reindex, SDK changes, estimated eng days) in the one-pager.
Asha V.: Thanks team. I'll post call notes and procurement timeline here after the health sync. Paste any procurement or bench details into this thread. :pray:
